# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `easyship` MCP server pointing at `https://mcp.easyship.com/mcp`.
- Auth uses OAuth with PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration against `mcp.easyship.com` — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: Easyship's official mark, from `github.com/easyship/easyship-mcp-plugin`.
